transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is I’m tired of avoiding things. I keep staying away from my workshop, and I skip family get-togethers if there’s a chance my brother-in-law might be there. After all this time, I’m just worn out from planning my life around not running into those reminders.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about things most days, even when there isn’t a specific reason?
I don’t know that I’d say most days. I mean, I get uneasy around certain things, but just sitting around worrying for no clear reason… I haven’t really noticed that.
Can you describe what happens when you're faced with those reminders or situations you avoid? Do you feel intense anxiety or panic in those moments?

Yeah… it’s mostly that I try not to let it get that far. If I think my brother-in-law might be at a family thing, I just don’t go. And I’ve been staying out of my workshop too, because it brings things up. I wouldn’t say I’m having a full panic attack every time, but I get uncomfortable enough that I steer clear. I’m tired of arranging everything around avoiding those reminders.
Have you ever found yourself repeatedly experiencing memories, thoughts, or feelings related to a specific upsetting or traumatic event?

Yes. It’ll come up out of nowhere sometimes. I’ll be shaving, or working on a painting, and suddenly I see his hand with that heavy tool again, like a picture in my head. It still makes my chest tighten when it happens.
